summary: DDC Enterprise filed a 424B5 preliminary prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of DDC SAVOR 13.5% Perpetual Cumulative Preferred Series A shares at $20.00 per share against a $25.00 stated value and liquidation preference. Investors committed 1,200,000 shares ($30M stated value) for $24M gross, some payable in non-cash digital assets converted to USD at closing. Dividends accrue at 13.5% ($3.375/share annually) plus bitcoin-linked bonus dividends up to $4.00; optional redemption at $25.00 from November 2029 or $26.25 earlier. A concurrent underwritten offering of at least 200,000 shares is conditioned on the private leg closing. Watch conversion mechanics and preferred overhang versus ordinary equity.
